page.overview:
Who is Mailaine Harvole?

Circa , Mailaine was one of more than twelve women who sat for her ajah (note the lowercase), in discussion of building a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}}

It is highly likely that Mailaine became a renegade Aes Sedai after the talks of , because from a letter dated , it is stated that after the stilling of Lideine Rajan, Mailaine ceased her resistance and led her followers to kneel.

It is not known if also Mailaine was stilled or instead enrolled in the White Tower.
